qualification.preference_comparison: Validate exact app canonical JSON bytes/hash and effective values first. Raw effective_initial_sha256 includes the unique Illiquid.agent-ui-preference-suite.v1 reservation and normally differs per run. Compare validated effective values with only that reservation removed, matching isolation mode and seed hash; retain complete raw receipts. This does not materialize unpersisted code defaults.

scenario_examples.setup: SETUP: loaded generated video fixture; player focused, VoiceOver off, default shortcuts; controls-always-visible false and benchmark chrome pin disabled. No menu, popover or focus pins; pointer stationary. A real Space play transition hides controls, and a real Space pause transition reveals them. Hooks only establish setup/read state; no pointer, timeout, or presented-frame qualification.

scenario_examples.setup: SETUP: one visible focused player and no other app windows or modals; shared benchmark preference domain; verify effective preferences before use. No media fixture. Command-comma and Command-W are real native menu shortcuts. This requests Settings, observes a second owned window, inspects, sends close, and checks player focus return. It does not identify Settings content; per-control settings changes and menu traversal remain pending.
scenario_examples.current_prerequisites: Owned launch requires a validated session-suite-only preference receipt with no fallback; retain optional seed bytes/hash and effective values. The setup field mirrors the scenario description verbatim, including its obsolete shared-domain wording, for reference consistency. Follow the current preference contract and runbook; initialization isolation does not qualify Settings controls.

scenario_examples.setup: Real pointer drag of the AX-hidden timeline grip using fresh app-published NSView/window-to-Quartz geometry. Requires a loaded seekable video, one focused player window, visible chrome, unlocked controls and idle physical input. Pauses via hook setup; asserts movement, released interaction pins and no accidental seek. Input and model geometry outcome only; live and presentation qualification require separate receipts. The historical filename is retained for inventory references.
